propositions: Project overlay entries keyed by built-in overlay id must support additive trigger_tokens (literal substring matches on diff lines) and applies_to globs that union with committed triggers.
A new helper function project_trigger_extensions must read project overlay raw entries and return per-overlay-id trigger extensions without using effective_routing's replace semantics.
Both glob_triggered_overlays and content_triggered_overlays must consume project trigger extensions via the helper, with repo_root threaded from overlay_union.
Trigger tokens match case-sensitively against added and removed lines of unified diffs, excluding file headers.
Malformed project entries (non-list tokens, non-string token values, unknown overlay ids) must be silently ignored without raising exceptions.
With no project overlay present, both trigger functions must produce identical results to current behavior, preserving ADR 0074 semantics for empty applies_to.
